original_requests.text: Add a gs batch capability: submit a chain of durable acts in one invocation with a single fold reconstruction. Independent of the ceremony changes — tonight's five-act filing took minutes of wall clock because each act paid a cold fold.

body.conditions: gs batch reads an ordered act chain (file or stdin), supports intra-batch rests-on references so a later act can cite an earlier act's not-yet-minted event id, validates and appends the chain with one fold pass, honors per-act idempotency keys so a retried batch never duplicates a landed prefix, and reports typed per-act outcomes. Implemented on a named branch with tests, through independent exact-head review.

original_requests.text: Repair gs batch after exact-head review: reject all trailing input before the first append and prove recovery from a partially landed prefix.

body.conditions: Replace the invalid decoder.More whole-input check with an EOF-proving second decode; add a mutation-sensitive test where a valid array followed by malformed trailing bytes or a delimiter exits nonzero and leaves head/depth unchanged; add direct coverage where only a prefix previously landed, then retry the full batch and observe replayed prefix plus newly landed suffix without duplication. Preserve the one-workspace kernel path and all prior conditions. Commit with this request as Rests-On, issue a replacement artifact/report for the new exact head, and request fresh independent review.

historical_approval.text: APPROVED at exact clean head faac00510dfedada82e2ab4cc45a48a216893c86. readBatch proves EOF with a second decode, so all tested trailing delimiters, values, unterminated input, and malformed bytes fail before app.Open while whitespace remains valid. The partial-prefix retry replays exactly the durable prefix by idempotency key, resolves its label to the original event, and lands only the suffix. Mutation checks restore decoder.More and remove the idempotency key; the targeted tests fail in exactly those cases. The one-workspace submit path, kernel envelope/signature/admission/ceiling/dedup/signing/CAS boundaries, typed outcomes, preflight labels, server parity, and documentation remain intact. Focused batch tests, make vet/test, go test -race ./cmd/gs/..., diff, exact head/trailers, cleanliness, and fsck pass. No edits or merge performed.
